correctness.rationale: The nonzero pair-sum fiber is forced by the polar-form equation to one unordered pair, while the zero fiber consists of all antipodal pairs. This yields \(W=2T^2-\sum t_i^2-2\sum r_i^2+4|\sum z_i|^2\). Exact algebra then gives the four displayed deficit terms. Their nonnegativity follows from Cauchy--Schwarz, \(t_i\ge2r_i\), and the triangle inequality. Character orthogonality converts the energy identity to the normalized extension deficit. Equality forces and is forced by constant modulus plus a common antipodal-product phase. Exact replay verifies both split and anisotropic representatives over ten prime fields.
